source.title: Let's Sing 2027
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Lyrics, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol and TobaccoIn-Game PurchasesGamesLet's Sing 2027VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalLyrics, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol and TobaccoIn-Game PurchasesLoadingSing your heart out with your friends on your favorite songs in our 1 to 4 players karaoke game.Grab the mic—or your smartphone—and get ready to shine! Let’s Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics from around the world. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable duets and group performances. Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let’s Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. Whether you’re hosting a party or chasing your best score, it’s your turn to take center stage!This year, step into Soundtown in an all-new Party mode—a lively musical adventure where you’ll face off against DJ Hush and bring the beat back to the city. With improved visuals, fresh avatars, and customizable rewards, every performance feels like a moment in the spotlight.Featuring 35 chart-topping songs there's something for everyone—from modern hits to timeless classics.* Chappell Roan – The Subway* Lady Gaga, Bruno Mars – Die With A Smile* Alex Warren – Ordinary * Drake – God's Plan * Ariana Grande – we can't be friends (wait for your love)* Sabrina Carpenter – Espresso * Ed Sheeran – Azizam ... And many more!This product is not sold on its own.Software description provided by the publisher.Explore this game's official websiteRelated tagsMusicOnline scoreboardsPlay for a high scoreMeet up and play togetherPlay together on one consoleShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)3.9 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1-4)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 8Blood, Language, ViolenceGamesCRYMELIGHTReleases 11/4/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalSale ends: 11/4/26 at 02:59 p.m. UTCBlood, Language, ViolenceLoadingView DLCA roguelike action game where you face your sins. The greater your penance, the stronger you become."I'll make these sins mean something."Pure maidens shoulder sin for the sake of love; the more they repent, the stronger they grow.At the brink of resolve and madness lies a tale that will grip your heart.[Story]"You are all sinners."This is Wonderland, a prison for the souls of the dead.A girl bereft of her memories is granted the name "Alice" by her guide, the White Rabbit.She is led to the site of a tea party.There, Alice learns of a rule:In this game, only those who can defeat the Queen are granted freedom.And so, Alice joins forces with a mysterious girl called Mary and resolves to participate in the game to return to her world.Whenever she comes into contact with the sins of her companions, she is able to see the painful pasts they experienced....Why did the Queen create this world?And what awaits the victor? Salvation... or retribution?[Game System]A roguelike action game in which you venture out into Wonderland, ruled by the Queen, while battling to the death against her forces.An innocent girl who wields sin to fight in the land of the dead.Wonder DimensionThe moment an enemy is slain, an indigo "Wonder Dimension" will spread across the field.As the dimension expands, your abilities will grow stronger and the action will speed up.Your acquired skills determine how quickly the dimension expands and the way in which your abilities are enhanced, changing the way you approach battles.Poker SystemCollect 5 skill cards to form poker-style hands.Stronger combinations result in stronger effects, changing the course of the battle with different attacks and tactics.What cards do you hold onto? What hands will you aim for? Your choices will determine victory or defeat.Repentance SystemConfess the sins you have shouldered in your death battles and transform them into power.Alice will take on the sins of the wayward souls she defeats along the way.The tears of penitence will become power-up items for you to use.Powering UpUse the materials you obtain through repentance to make your weapons and accessories more powerful.Even if you are thrown back in time and lose your cards, you can keep some progress through this.Next time, aim to go deeper; go farther.Tea PartiesA place where all participants gather, mingle, and prepare themselves for the next battle.The girls may touch on various things such as their pasts and may even divulge surprising details about slain foes.[Creators]Story written by Naoki Hisaya. Music by Sakuzyo. Character design by YOGISYA.[Cast]Alice: Sayaka SenbongiMary: Hitomi SekineCheshire: Yukina ShutoMad: Nao OjikaMarch: Yurina AmamiWhite Rabbit: Yu SasaharaSoftware description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):【Pre-order Bonus】 - CRYMELIGHT - Red Pouch*Pre-order bonus is available for customers who purchase by 23:59 (JST) on November 4, 2026.*Pre-order bonuses may be distributed at a later date.About this itemGame file size (estimated)5.9 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
